about: A tool that turns code coverage files into readable reports.

prs.title: Coverage files with line checksums report the right coverage
prs.broken: Some coverage files add a checksum to each line. The tool read it as part of the hit count, so every line looked covered and an 80% project showed 100%.
prs.changed: I made it read only the hit count and ignore the checksum.
prs.matters: Coverage reports show the real number instead of a reassuring wrong one.
